methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College partners with Google for free AI training - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Google partnership with Roanoke College to deliver free AI training signals potential for distributed capability-building in a non-metro region, though depth depends on whether training creates genuine fluency or surface-level exposure.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk native organizing free community AI workshops to close technology gaps represents grassroots, peer-network-driven distribution of AI literacy outside traditional metro hubs, classic 'Build It Yourself' activation pattern.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates institutional AI education resources in state capital region, likely deepening metro capability while leaving rural-metro transfer mechanisms unclear.

signals.title: George Mason student teaches DC-area seniors how to spot AI scams
signals.signal_reading: George Mason student teaching seniors AI scam detection exemplifies peer-to-peer knowledge transfer building practical AI fluency from the bottom up, though concentrated in metro DMV area.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: Old Dominion summer camp for youth cybersecurity and AI education concentrates advanced technical training in Hampton Roads institutional hub, building deep capability but limited to those with access to university programs.
